semantics.p1y: (p1a AND p1b AND p1c) OR (p1d AND p1e AND p1f)
semantics.timing: Pure combinational response to current inputs; no clock or cycle latency, no specified physical delay.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.

numeric.arithmetic: No addition, signed arithmetic, rounding, overflow, or saturation.

verification.method: Independent self-checking exhaustive binary truth-table test over all 1024 input combinations.
verification.oracle: For each AND group, compare its packed input group to the all-ones value; output is true if either group matches.
verification.observation: Allow one testbench time unit for combinational settling, then compare both outputs with case inequality.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite compile and simulation timeouts.
verification.pass: All 1024 combinations match, with explicit PASS marker.
